title: Confirmation of Non-Occupancy and Its Reversal — Occupancy and Residency Certification
content:
**Article 1 — Evidence.** Under the Occupancy and Residency Certification product, non-occupancy is confirmed only from the records the plan lists as non-occupancy evidence: a vacant or occupied-by-others inspection finding, the borrower's own written permanent-move statement, or a health-care absence that exceeded its limit. A third party's oral statement is never enough, per the plan's caller-statement setting.

**Article 2 — Health-care absence limit.** Non-occupancy is confirmed for a health-care absence only when the plan's consecutive-month limit (12 calendar months under every plan) has passed since the facility admission date, read as the absence start date on the profile record. The limit is reached on the same day number in the month 12 calendar months after the absence start date, falling back to the last day of that month when that day does not exist, and confirmation is allowed only on a later day, because the absence must exceed the limit.

| Hypothetical absence start date | Limit reached on | First day confirmation is allowed |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March | 15 March of the following year | 16 March of the following year |
| 29 February of a leap year | 28 February of the following year (no 29 February) | 1 March of the following year |

On the day the limit is reached itself, confirmation is not yet allowed.

**Article 3 — Basis.** A health-care confirmation uses the basis *health-care absence limit exceeded*; every other confirmation uses the basis *not principal residence*, including an absence for other reasons longer than the plan's non-health absence limit in days within a 12-month period.

**Article 4 — Maturity case.** Confirmation opens a case on the loan under Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases on the confirmation date: an Extended Health-Care Absence case for the basis health-care absence limit exceeded, and a Principal Residence Change case for the basis not principal residence.

**Article 5 — Reversal.** On plans whose reoccupancy-cure setting is yes, a confirmed non-occupancy is reversed when a borrower resumes occupancy and completes a certification before the related maturity case reaches due and payable status; the profile becomes current and the maturity case is cured. The related maturity case's status is read from its own record and must still show opened or awaiting HUD approval.

## Condition–result table

| Records show | Basis | Case opened |
|---|---|---|
| inspection finding vacant | not principal residence | Principal Residence Change |
| inspection finding occupied by others | not principal residence | Principal Residence Change |
| borrower's written permanent-move statement | not principal residence | Principal Residence Change |
| health-care absence past its limit | health-care absence limit exceeded | Extended Health-Care Absence |
| only a neighbour's or relative's telephone account | no confirmation | none |
